editions.headline: Uncle_Jim Turned $10,000 Into $30.54 While XgonGivIt2ya Went Back-to-Back With His Hands in His Pockets
editions.teaser: Uncle_Jim cashes five small winners and still finishes −$9,969.46 with $0.00 in cash, while XgonGivIt2ya wins Friday at +$1,632.85 sitting 100% in cash for W2. SlowPonies wipes to zero, StankGravy passes the accountant as the crew's top earner without a single win, and the two rivals send the same chirp for the second straight day.

editions.headline: XgonGivIt2ya Bet Everything But 97 Cents and Mugged the Accountant on Thanksgiving
editions.teaser: XgonGivIt2ya goes from −$9,222.31 to a +$8,061.88 win with $0.97 left in cash, beating Uncle_Jim by $979.30 and killing the W5 streak.
